官方默认·夏日独立流行: Upbeat indie pop with warm female vocals, bright electric guitars, punchy drums, melodic bass, and subtle synth layers. Catchy and energetic, with an uplifting summer atmosphere, a memorable chorus, and polished modern production.
流行情歌: Contemporary pop ballad, intimate expressive lead vocals, piano-led verses with rounded bass and restrained drums. Straight ballad pulse, sustained melodic phrases and space for breath. Strings enter in the second verse; the chorus opens into a fuller band, followed by a quiet final resolution. Clear close vocals and controlled reverb.
木吉他民谣: Acoustic storytelling folk, natural conversational lead vocals, fingerpicked steel-string guitar and upright bass. Gentle alternating-bass pulse, subtle hand percussion and short harmonica answers. Keep verses spare, add a second guitar in the refrain, and finish with an exposed acoustic ending. Organic room sound and modest dynamics.
史诗悲壮: Tragic cinematic ballad, restrained low-register verses rising into an anguished sustained chorus. Somber piano, low strings, French horns and distant orchestral drums; broad half-time pulse with long pauses. Build tension through descending melodic gestures and layered strings, then end on a subdued unresolved feeling. Dark spacious orchestral sound.
钢琴抒情: Intimate piano ballad, softly articulated lead vocals with unhurried phrasing. Delicate arpeggiated piano, cello counterlines and occasional brushed cymbals; minimal bass movement. Leave silence between phrases, develop the melody through small variations, and keep the refrain lyrical rather than explosive. Close piano detail and a small warm room.
热血摇滚: Arena rock, forceful sustained lead vocals, distorted rhythm guitars, driving eighth-note bass and strong snare backbeats. Palm-muted verses expand into open power chords and a chant-like chorus; add a melodic guitar solo before the final refrain. Tight live-band energy, big drums and clearly separated guitars.
慢摇电子: Mid-tempo melodic electronic pop, smooth restrained lead vocals, deep synth bass, soft pads and a steady four-on-the-floor kick. Gentle sidechain motion, sparse syncopated plucks and a repeated melodic hook. Filtered verses lead into a restrained instrumental drop; avoid an aggressive festival climax. Deep clean low end and spacious stereo textures.
国风流行: Contemporary Chinese-inspired pop, graceful lyrical lead vocals, guzheng figures, erhu responses, piano and modern drums. Flowing pentatonic phrases over a steady pop backbeat; leave space for traditional instruments between sung lines. A restrained verse grows into a sweeping melodic chorus. Balance acoustic ornamentation with a clear modern rhythm section.
复古港风: Classic Hong Kong pop ballad, expressive sustained lead vocals with measured vibrato. Electric piano, clean guitar fills, melodic electric bass, live drums and lush strings. A broad straight ballad groove, long vocal arcs and a brief instrumental interlude. Gradually widen the final chorus. Warm tape-like texture and rich studio reverb.
R&B灵魂: Contemporary slow R&B, intimate lead vocals with restrained melisma and breathy phrase endings. Rhodes chords, deep sub bass, sparse syncopated kick and snare, and silky pads. Laid-back pocket, offbeat vocal entries and short call-and-response harmonies. Keep the hook compact and the arrangement uncluttered. Dry close vocals with spacious background textures.
爵士酒馆: Small-club jazz ballad, smoky conversational lead vocals, acoustic piano trio, upright bass and brushed drums. Gentle swing and relaxed behind-the-beat phrasing; saxophone answers only between vocal lines. Spare verses, tasteful piano voicings and a short improvised instrumental passage. Warm room ambience, natural dynamics and no oversized pop climax.
城市放克: Urban funk-pop, rhythmic articulated lead vocals, muted sixteenth-note guitar, slap bass, dry drums and punchy brass stabs. Tight syncopation, stop-time breaks and a bass-led groove. Use short repeated vocal hooks and instrumental responses; keep the arrangement crisp rather than lush. Dry upfront rhythm section and sharply defined attacks.
梦幻流行: Accessible dream pop, soft floating lead vocals, chorus-treated guitars, gentle synth pads and a steady understated drum groove. Clear melodic hooks with long shimmering tails. Keep verses intimate, widen the chorus with stacked textures, and finish with a drifting fade. Smooth luminous production while retaining a clear vocal melody.
伤感慢歌: Sparse melancholic pop ballad, fragile close lead vocals, low piano chords and occasional muted guitar. Slow straight pulse with minimal percussion; descending phrases, hesitant entrances and long held endings. Keep the first chorus almost bare, add restrained strings late, and end with voice and piano. Intimate dry detail rather than cinematic grandeur.
治愈轻音乐歌: Gentle acoustic vocal pop, soothing softly articulated lead vocals, fingerpicked guitar, light piano and rounded bass. An easy even pulse with quiet shaker and brushed snare. Short lyrical phrases, a modest comforting refrain and small instrumental answers. Keep the energy calm throughout, with clear natural acoustics and no dramatic build.
流行朋克: Fast pop punk, youthful direct lead vocals, crunchy power chords, pick-played bass and rapid live drums. Driving eighth-note guitars, energetic snare backbeats and quick fills. Tight verse-to-chorus transitions, a shout-along refrain and a half-time bridge before the final chorus. Bright aggressive band sound with little ambient padding.
重金属: Melodic heavy metal, powerful gritty lead vocals, tightly doubled distorted guitars, double-kick drums and heavy bass. Precise riff-driven rhythm, alternating chugging passages and sustained melodic phrases. Add harmonized guitar leads and a brief solo; use a dramatic half-time breakdown before the final refrain. Dense but articulate guitars and controlled low end.
嘻哈说唱: Melodic hip-hop, clearly articulated rhythmic verses and a compact sung hook. Dry kick and snare, deep 808 bass, a sparse piano sample and subtle atmospheric textures. Syncopated flows with deliberate rests and small hi-hat variations. Drop the drums for a short transition, then return to the main groove. Upfront vocal intelligibility and uncluttered production.
拉丁夏日: Acoustic Latin pop, light playful lead vocals, nylon-string guitar, shakers, hand percussion and melodic bass. Breezy syncopated groove with gentle bossa-influenced guitar patterns. Easy melodic verses, a relaxed singalong refrain and a short guitar interlude. Warm open-air atmosphere and light acoustic production.
乡村公路: Modern country road song, warm storytelling lead vocals, strummed acoustic guitar, pedal steel, electric bass and steady live drums. A rolling train-like pulse, clear syllabic phrasing and twangy instrumental fills. Add fiddle or steel responses between lines, with a broad open chorus and a brief guitar solo. Natural band sound and warm vocal presence.
电影主题曲: Cinematic orchestral pop theme, lyrical lead vocals and a clear recurring melody. Piano introduces the theme; strings, woodwinds and orchestral percussion expand it gradually. Flowing measured pulse, long melodic arcs and a quieter bridge before the thematic return. Emphasize emotional continuity and orchestral color over a heavy drum groove.
LoFi卧室流行: Lo-fi bedroom pop, intimate lightly sung lead vocals, muted guitar, soft electric piano and dusty sampled drums. Slightly loose relaxed groove, small repetitive melodic cells and restrained bass. Keep the chorus understated, with a brief instrumental loop and a gentle ending. Narrow cozy textures, subtle tape wear and close informal vocals.
迪斯科舞曲: Contemporary disco-pop, confident rhythmic lead vocals, four-on-the-floor kick, clean funk guitar, active bass and bright synth hooks. Crisp dance-floor pulse with handclaps and short rhythmic vocal phrases. Build into a hook-led chorus and a bass-focused dance break. Tight modern low end and sparkling clean percussion.
华语青春校园: Youthful campus acoustic pop, clear unforced lead vocals, bright strummed guitar, piano and a light band groove. Straight buoyant pulse and easy syllabic melodies. Storytelling verses lead to a simple communal singalong chorus; add light backing harmonies near the end. Fresh acoustic detail, natural room sound and hopeful restraint.
都市夜色City Pop: Late-night Japanese city-pop-inspired arrangement, smooth melodic lead vocals, electric piano, clean chorus guitar, rounded fingerstyle bass and relaxed live drums. Subtle syncopation with jazz-colored chords and saxophone fills. Silky verses, a breezy melodic chorus and a polished instrumental interlude. Warm analog sheen and spacious night-drive ambience.
梦幻独立Dream Pop: Atmospheric indie dream pop, hushed distant lead vocals, delay-soaked guitars, slow-moving synth clouds and minimal drums. Hypnotic repeating figures, blurred phrase boundaries and a patient gradual build instead of a conventional large chorus. Let guitar textures carry the transitions. Hazy wide ambience and subdued vocal presence.
英伦另类摇滚: British alternative guitar rock, earnest slightly gritty lead vocals, jangly rhythm guitar, melodic bass and lively live drums. Propulsive straight groove with a few offbeat guitar accents. Narrow tense verses open into a wide melodic refrain; add a contrasting guitar countermelody and a brief stripped bridge. Raw-edged band dynamics with clear vocal focus.
后摇氛围: Post-rock vocal song, restrained sparse lead vocals, interlocking delay guitars, deep bass and slowly developing live drums. Repeating melodic motifs evolve through texture and dynamics rather than frequent hooks. Begin nearly bare, build in long waves to a guitar-led climax, then decay into ambience. Wide spatial sound and strong quiet-to-loud contrast.
灵魂福音: Soul-gospel song, expressive lead vocals with emphatic phrase endings and responsive backing harmonies. Piano, Hammond organ, bass and live drums. A rolling soulful groove, call-and-response refrains and gradual harmonic intensity. Start with solo voice and piano, then add choir responses and organ swells. Organic ensemble energy and rich vocal blend.
雷鬼阳光: Roots-reggae-inspired pop, relaxed rhythmic lead vocals, offbeat guitar chops, bubbling organ, deep bass and spacious drums. A laid-back one-drop feel with clear gaps in the rhythm. Short melodic hooks, bass-led instrumental passages and occasional percussion accents. Warm low end, dry guitar skank and generous dub-like space.
拉丁热情: Energetic salsa-inspired Latin pop, assertive rhythmic lead vocals, piano montuno patterns, tumbao bass, congas, timbales and brass. Interlocking syncopation and bright percussion breaks. Use a responsive chorus, short brass answers and an extended rhythmic dance passage. Live ensemble energy and clear separation of percussion layers.
探戈戏剧: Dramatic tango song, precise emotionally charged lead vocals, bandoneon, violin, piano and double bass. Sharp accented pulses, sudden pauses and alternating clipped and sustained phrases. Tense verses move into an expansive melodic refrain, followed by a bandoneon-led interlude. Intimate theatrical acoustics with strong dynamic contrasts.
凯尔特幻想: Celtic folk song, clear flowing lead vocals, fiddle, tin whistle, harp, acoustic guitar and bodhran. Lilting compound-feel rhythm and ornamented instrumental responses. Narrative verses lead into a communal refrain; alternate sung passages with a lively fiddle-and-whistle interlude. Natural acoustic blend and an adventurous open landscape feel.
东方禅意: Contemplative East Asian acoustic song, quiet unhurried lead vocals, guqin, bamboo flute and sparse low strings. Spacious phrasing with soft isolated percussion and long silences. Keep melodies modest and ornamentation delicate; let flute answer the voice without a large pop chorus. Dry plucked-string detail and gentle natural reverberation.
武侠江湖: Wuxia cinematic song, bold expressive lead vocals, erhu, bamboo flute, pipa and orchestral strings. Strong martial drum accents alternate with lyrical spacious passages. Pentatonic melodic gestures, a resolute refrain and a contrasting flute-led bridge. Heroic momentum with bittersweet melodic turns and dramatic acoustic depth.
童谣轻快: Playful nursery-rhyme-style song, bright gentle lead vocals with clear simple articulation. Ukulele, toy piano, glockenspiel and soft hand percussion. A bouncing even pulse, short stepwise melodies and repeated easy phrases. Use small call-and-response moments and playful instrument answers. Friendly light production without dense bass or dramatic effects.
音乐剧叙事: Narrative musical-theater song, articulate expressive lead vocals with speech-like verses and sustained emotional peaks. Piano-led accompaniment expands into strings and woodwinds. Follow the vocal phrasing with dynamic accents, pauses and changing accompaniment density. Build toward a dramatic melodic reprise rather than a looped pop hook. Clear theatrical vocal presence.
复古迪斯科: Late-1970s disco arrangement, buoyant soulful lead vocals, octave-driven electric bass, clipped funk guitar, strings, brass and four-on-the-floor drums. Open hi-hats and a continuous dance groove. Repeated ensemble refrains lead to an extended strings-and-bass break. Warm live-orchestra texture and vintage studio ambience.
暗黑电子: Minimal dark electronic pop, low intimate lead vocals, ominous synth bass, sparse broken beats and metallic percussion. Tense repeating motifs, whispered-to-firm vocal dynamics and deliberate empty space. Gradually introduce distorted textures, then strip the final section back. Cold close detail, deep low end and narrow unsettling ambience.
未来感Synthwave: Retro-futuristic synthwave song, smooth sustained lead vocals, analog polysynth chords, pulsing octave bass, sequenced arpeggios and gated snare. Steady driving electronic pulse and broad melodic lines. A restrained verse opens into a wide synth-led chorus, with an instrumental arpeggio break. Saturated analog color and cinematic night-drive depth.
摇篮曲温柔: Tender lullaby song, very soft close lead vocals, gentle piano, celesta and occasional sustained strings. Slow rocking pulse, narrow-range stepwise melody and repeated soothing phrases. Maintain quiet dynamics with no percussion climax; finish with a short fading piano figure. Warm intimate sound and soft attacks throughout.
史诗凯旋: Triumphant orchestral anthem, resolute projected lead vocals, heroic brass, rising strings, timpani and large ensemble drums. Firm marching pulse and ascending melodic gestures. Build from a focused statement to a broad choral refrain, with a brass-led return of the theme. Bright grand orchestration and decisive cadences.
